title: Good Things Are Coming
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
An army camped around the town,
The walls were high and gray;
But Jeremiah heard the Lord
Say, "Buy a field today."

[Chorus]
Good things are coming, wait and see,
His promises are true;
So plant a seed of hope today,
And He will see it through.

[Verse 2]
He weighed out seventeen bright coins
And signed it, true and fair;
Then Baruch sealed it in a jar
Of clay and kept it there.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Why buy a field when soldiers stood
Outside the city wall?
The Lord had promised fields and homes
Would come again for all.

[Chorus]

[Verse 4]
Beau planted one small seed and poured
His water every day;
The dirt stayed bare, but he kept on,
Till green came up to stay.

[Chorus]
mood: Planting music. A steady, patient strum like a hand pressing seeds into a row, one beat to a seed, never hurried, the step of a man walking out to buy a field while an army waits outside the wall. Fingerpicked nylon guitar keeps the row going, an upright bass note on the first beat of each bar underneath. It stays small and even through the hard verses and opens a little by the last one, like a first green shoot in a paper cup in the morning sun.
